0.title: Course Substitution Application
0.body: Undergraduate and graduate students who want to have course substitution must apply within the following dates. Application Dates: Applications will be received until 16.30 on the last day on the following dates. Undergraduate & Graduate (Except for the programs mentioned below): April 30 – June 4, 2025 Information Technology, Data Analytics, Energy Technologies and Management, Cyber Security, Digital Transformation in Industry (non-thesis): April 30 - May 30, 2025 Business Analytics, Finance, Executive Master of Business Administration, Action Research and Transformation, Business Administration for Professionals, Marketing (non-thesis): July 21 - August 22, 2025 How to Apply? It is done through the Student Information System (Bannerweb). The application steps are as follows: Log in to the Information System page. Click on the “Student & Financial Aid” option. The "Request to Course Subtitution Form" in the "Registration" field is created by selecting all courses to be substituted at once. Since it is an electronic approval system, there is no need to bring the form printout to the Student Resources Unit. Applications can be viewed from the transcript upon the announcement of end-of-term grades. You can find detailed information on the Student Resources internal web page.

7.title: About Suspension of Educational Activities
7.body: Dear Students, Due to the earthquake that occurred in Istanbul on April 23, 2025, and in accordance with the decision taken by the Council of Higher Education (YÖK), all universities in Istanbul will suspend educational activities on April 24–25, 2025. Within this scope, there will be no classes held at our University on the specified dates. Additionally, the exams that were scheduled to take place on our Tuzla Campus over the weekend (April 26–27) will be postponed to a later date to be determined by the respective course instructors. Updates and information regarding new exam schedules and further developments will be communicated to you by the relevant academic departments. We kindly present this for your information and wish you all good health.

11.title: Application to Double Major and Minor Programs
11.body: Students who wish to enroll in a double major or minor program for the 2024–2025 Academic Year Summer Term must apply within the dates specified below. Application Dates: April 28 – May 9, 2025 How to Apply? It is made online with the Student Petition Form, which must be submitted to the Dean’s Office of the Faculty hosting the double major or minor program. The application requirements must be fulfilled as of the beginning of the Summer Term when the evaluation will take place. Important Note for International Students For applications to FENS programs, in addition to other requirements, applicants must meet the condition of being ranked within the top 300,000 in the quantitative score type according to the YKS guide. Therefore, international students are not eligible to enroll in double major programs within FENS. You can find detailed information on the Student Resources internal web page.

12.title: Major Declaration and Diploma Program Change
12.body: Students who have not yet declared a diploma program or who wish to request a change of diploma program are required to submit their applications within the dates specified below: Application Dates: April 28 – May 9, 2025 Who Can Apply? A. Major Declaration: Students who have completed the following courses and are at least in their second semester of study are eligible to declare their diploma program: - SPS 101 - MATH 101 - NS 101 - HIST 191 - TLL 101 - AL 102 (ENG 101 for students admitted before the 2017–2018 academic year) - IF 100 (only for students admitted in the 2017–2018 academic year and later) Students who enrolled prior to the 2020–2021 academic year and who have not completed the above courses may still apply, provided they meet the previously established credit-based requirements. B. Diploma Program Change: Students who have already declared a diploma program and wish to transfer to a different one must apply through the internal transfer process. Application Procedures A. Major Declaration: Applications must be submitted through the Student Information System (Bannerweb) by following these steps: Log into the Information System page. Click on "Student & Financial Aid." Proceed through the "Degree Audit and Graduation" section and select "Major Declaration for Undergraduate Students" to complete your application. B. Diploma Program Change: Applications for a change of diploma program must be submitted online via the Student Petition Form and directed to the Dean’s Office of the relevant faculty. Important Note for International Students Applications for major declarations or program changes that involve a different type of admission score than the one originally used for university enrollment are considered within the scope of transfer procedures, in accordance with the regulations of the Council of Higher Education (YÖK). In accordance with the relevant YÖK regulations and decisions: - International students must meet the admission criteria applicable to the target program group for the year of their initial enrollment. However, students who were admitted based solely on their high school GPA are excluded from internal transfer regulations and therefore are not eligible to apply for a diploma program with a different admission score type or to transfer to another program. - Students who are in their fifth semester or later and who apply to declare or change a diploma program involving a different admission score type will have their applications evaluated under the provisions of Additional Article 1 (EK Madde-1) concerning horizontal transfers. Since international students do not have a central placement score (ÖSYM score), it is not possible for them to declare or transfer to a diploma program with a different admission score type. For detailed information, please visit the Student Resources internal website

15.title: Graduation Application for 2024-2025 Spring and Summer Semesters
15.body: All eligible students must submit a graduation application to ensure a smooth graduation process for the Spring and Summer Semesters of the 2024-2025 Academic Year. Failure to apply, even if all program requirements are met, will result in non-graduation. Graduation Application Period: March 17, 2025 - May 05, 2025 Who Can Apply? Undergraduate and graduate students set to fulfill program requirements by the end of the Spring and Summer Semesters are eligible. Previously applied students anticipating completion of the program requirements in the 2024-2025 Academic Year Spring and Summer Semesters must reapply. Application Procedure: Graduation applications are submitted through the Student Information System (Bannerweb). Follow these steps: Access the Information System page. Click on "Student  & Financial Aid" Navigate to "Degree Audit and Graduation" and complete the "Graduation Application Form" selecting the graduation period as 202402 - Spring 2024-2025 or 202403 - Summer 2024-2025. Tracking Graduation: Monitor your graduation progress via the Student Information System (Bannerweb) with the following steps: Access the Information System  page. Click on the "Student & Financial Aid" menu. Select "Grade Audit & Graduation" Click on "Degree Evaluation (Summary)" Choose the graduation period: 202402 – Spring 2024-2025 or 202403 - Summer 2024-2025. Click the "Generate New Request" button Detailed information is available on the Student Resources internal web page

16.title: Attention Foreign Students Undertaking Mandatory Internship in Turkey
16.body: To the Attention of Our Foreign Students Who Will Undertake a Mandatory Internship in Turkey As part of the mandatory internship program, "Accident at Work and Occupational Disease Insurance" is required. Undertaking an internship without this insurance will be considered a voluntary internship. However, within the scope of the new procedure of the Ministry of Labor, our foreign students who will do their mandatory internship in Turkey are required to get the e-Exemption Certificate. Without this document, the university does not cover insurance against “Accident at Work and Occupational Disease Insurance” by the university. For our foreign students who will do an internship within the scope of a Mandatory Internship, the university provides the e-Exemption Certificate through consultancy. To be able to get this document, the following documents must be sent to the intern@sabanciuniv.edu e-mail ADDRESS AT LEAST ONE MONTH BEFORE THE İNTERNSHIP START DATE after the institution/company where the internship will be done is finalized. Copy of passport ID page Copy of student residence in Turkey (single pdf) Active student document (student can obtain it from SR or e-government) Information form (prepared by consultancy firm for student to fill out) Internship acceptance document from the institution where the student did the internship (barcoded and cap-based, the company where the internship will be done was requested to prepare such a document) Full address of the company where the student will do the internship (can be written on the information form) If the student is married, spouse's name, surname and nationality Workplace internship contract (must be wet-signed and stamped by the student, the institution where the student will work and the rectorate/ It can be requested by the Career Development &Internship Office.) Internship letter (prepared by the Career Development &Internship Office) After the e-Exemption Certificate have received, it will be shared via the student’s e-mail address.
